question.text: Aqueous solution of orthoboric acid can be titrated against sodium hydroxide using phenolphthalein indicator only in presence of:

solution.text: It forms a stable cyclic complex with polyhydroxy compounds like cis-glycerol, catechol, etc. This helps in the release of <math><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>+</mo></mrow></msup><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>+</mo></mrow></msup></math> therefore, boric acid acts as a strong acid and hence can be titrated with sodium hydroxide using phenolphthalein.
